name: Derzkaja knjazhna
source:
Princess Ida is a proud student of the Royal Academy of Heroes but her father returned from the war and decided to arrange his daughter's personal life. How will his gamble turn out?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734830/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
艾达公主是皇家英雄学院的骄傲学生，但她的父亲从战争中归来，决定安排女儿的个人生活。他的赌局将会如何？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734830/]Steam[/url]]
